jobs.title: Senior People Operations Manager
jobs.description: Wordsmith Wordsmith is building the legal operations platform for in-house teams, and we are growing fast. We believe in-house legal is becoming one of the most important functions in the AI era. Every business is moving faster, but legal work is still too often scattered across inboxes, chats, documents, and disconnected systems. Wordsmith brings that work into one system. Requests come in from across the business, AI agents handle the routine, lawyers stay in control where judgment matters, and every step is captured as work happens. We are built for in-house legal, not law firms. Our goal is to help legal teams move faster, reduce unnecessary external counsel spend, and become a function the business can run with. More than 500 companies, including Financial Times, Safelite, Trip.com , Canva, Starling, and Sage, use Wordsmith. Backed by $100M from Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Highland Europe, and others, we are building one of the defining companies in legal AI. The Role You’ll own the operational backbone of our People function: payroll, global mobility, PEOs, commission and equity administration, HRIS, and the systems that keep everything in sync. This is a senior individual contributor role focused on clean operations, not a junior administrator position and not a People leadership seat. You'll operate the frameworks our leadership and Finance set (pay philosophy, salary bands, commission structure, equity strategy). Your job is to implement those decisions accurately and on time, with a clear audit trail, and with the judgment to stop or escalate anything that doesn't fit the framework or lacks proper approval. What You'll Do Own payroll controls and monthly validation across UK payroll, PEOs, and other employment models, with clean reconciliation to Finance each month Run visa and mobility operations end-to-end: sponsorships, relocations, compliance, right-to-work controls, and coordination with immigration advisers. Today, up to 25% of healthcare spending is lost in manual, repetitive administrative work. Legacy software hasn’t helped, it’s made things slower, more complex, and more frustrating for care teams. We believe AI agents can change that. Our technology combines Large Language Models with system-level automation to handle real work inside existing hospital tools. No integrations, no disruption. Our first agent automates coding workflows and frees up time for medical staff to focus on patients. We launched in 2024, are backed by top investors (Index, Frst, Y Combinator, Hexa, Kima Ventures, Better Angle), and we’re just getting started. Support Hiring Managers Be their point of contact and help them define their team strategy through hiring. jobs.description: Maak impact op HR, organisatie en medewerkers Wil jij als Senior HR Advisor complexe HR-vraagstukken vertalen naar praktisch en toekomstgericht HR-beleid? En krijg je energie van adviseren, verbeteren én zelf de handen uit de mouwen steken? Bij Priva werk je nauw samen met onze HR Business Partners, HR Director en HR Operations-collega's. Je bent een ervaren sparringpartner voor het HR-team en de business en draagt bij aan complexe HR-casuïstiek, organisatieontwikkeling en strategische HR-projecten. Je combineert een brede HR-expertise met een praktische aanpak. Van arbeidsrecht en verzuim tot HR-processen, beleid, data en systemen: jij weet wat er nodig is om onze HR-dienstverlening continu te verbeteren. Wat ga je doen? Als Senior HR Advisor : adviseer je over complexe HR-vraagstukken, arbeidsrecht, verzuim, arbeidsvoorwaarden en organisatieveranderingen; ondersteun je HR Business Partners en management bij individuele en collectieve HR-casuïstiek; draag je bij aan strategische HR-projecten rondom onder andere cultuur, organisatieontwikkeling, transformatie en HR-beleid; vertaal je HR-strategie en wet- en regelgeving naar duidelijke en werkbare processen en oplossingen; werk je samen met HR Operations aan een professionele en efficiënte HR-dienstverlening; analyseer en verbeter je HR-processen en systemen; zet je HR-data en technologie in om betere beslissingen en procesverbeteringen mogelijk te maken; werk je actief met HR-systemen zoals AFAS en kijk je verder dan alleen de gebruikerskant om processen slimmer in te richten. Wie ben jij? Je bent een ervaren HR-professional die gemakkelijk schakelt tussen strategie, advies en uitvoering. Je hebt een stevige inhoudelijke HR-basis, maar kijkt tegelijkertijd verder: waar kunnen processen beter, welke impact heeft een verandering op de organisatie en wat hebben managers en medewerkers nodig? Je bent kritisch wanneer dat nodig is, praktisch wanneer het kan en weet verschillende stakeholders mee te nemen in veranderingen

jobs.title: Senior Specialist II, Talent Acquisition
jobs.description: Step into a career with ASM, where cutting edge technology meets collaborative culture. ​ For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what’s next, at the forefront of innovation and what’s technologically possible. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving. But we’re more than just a tech company. We value diversity, inclusion and sustainability as we strive to make a positive impact on the world.  Our development programs help support your growth, shaping your future and pushing the boundaries of innovation to unleash potential.       At ASM, we are shaping the future of semiconductor manufacturing through innovation and technology leadership. Our success depends on attracting and hiring exceptional talent across engineering, commercial, service, and leadership functions. We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist to join our European Talent Acquisition team and serve as a trusted advisor to senior business leaders across Europe and North America.   The Role   As a Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist, you will lead the end-to-end recruitment of experienced professionals and senior leaders across multiple business functions and geographies. This is a highly visible role requiring exceptional stakeholder management, market intelligence, and proactive sourcing capabilities.   You will partner closely with senior leaders to identify, attract, and secure top talent in a highly competitive semiconductor market. Success in this role requires a strong executive presence, the ability to influence at all levels, and a proactive, data-driven approach to talent acquisition.   This role is based in Almere and will serve as a key Talent Acquisition partner supporting hiring across Europe and the United States.   Key Responsibilities &

jobs.title: Contracts Manager Federal
jobs.description:
$100,000 - $120,000 a year Akicita Federal, LLC is a growing 8(a) small business that delivers healthcare, professional, and administrative services to federal agencies. We're adding a contracts manager to help us grow beyond our current work. The job is to find opportunities, write winning proposals quickly, and build lasting relationships with agencies and teaming partners. What you'll do Find and respond to federal opportunities, focusing on small business and 8(a) set-asides Write, assemble, and submit proposals at high volume, often turning one around in a day or two Manage contracts after award: point of contact for agencies, modifications, compliance, and reporting Spend about a quarter of your time on teaming and partnership outreach to other small businesses Work with our recruiting team to staff new awards Use AI tools to work faster. We expect speed and don't want proposals built by hand from scratch. What you bring 3+ years in federal contracting: contracts management, proposal writing, capture, or program management Solid understanding of the FAR, set-aside programs, and the federal procurement process An existing network of agency or contractor relationships is a strong plus You're comfortable with AI tools, or eager to become a power user You'd rather submit ten good proposals than polish one forever

jobs.title: Human Resources Intern
jobs.description: The Organization & Employee Development Intern will support the HR team in employee engagement activities, training and development, and organization development. The role involves assisting with planning, coordination, documentation, and program support while gaining practical experience in HR operations and communication. Core Responsibilities: Documentation & Logistics Support: Assist in preparing HR program materials, coordinating event logistics, maintaining accurate records, organizing files, and communicating schedules and requirements to participants. Program Implementation Support: Support the execution of employee engagement and development activities by facilitating sessions, assisting speakers, monitoring program delivery, collecting feedback, and ensuring smooth event operations. Event Proposal Development: Help conceptualize and prepare employee engagement event proposals, conduct research, collaborate with stakeholders, create multimedia materials for internal communications, and develop a comprehensive event proposal from planning through execution.
